game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Merchant Wharf, the merchant wharf: the sailor must handle storm gulls while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Discount Rules: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount.
theme: Coastal Port – Merchant Wharf: the merchant wharf
core_gameplay_loop: In Merchant Wharf, repeat each round: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount. Each round, storm gulls strike the signal flag, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the profit value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the signal flag from storm gulls in Merchant Wharf: keep the profit meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: profit drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 2 (intro tier): Discount Rules
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Discount Rules' (Week 3 slot 10), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Merchant Wharf'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm gulls in Merchant Wharf.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 26 seconds while profit > 0.
